request: Run once exact final AI Core PR#3 unit suite with model processes stopped inside small isolated Docker using existing offline image. Reuse prior router tests and 4 Gate model actual inference evidence; publish only test count/conclusion, not raw logs.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
w=/home/admin1/projects/ai-core/.worktrees/pr3-verification-20261015
test "$(git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD)" = 01ef4da9ac2b468805179f74925858e6764ef68e
test -z "$(git -C "$w" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
rc=0
output=$(docker run --rm --network none --cpus 1 --memory 512m -v "$w:/src:ro" -w /src -e PYTHONPATH=/src --entrypoint python3 ai-core-model-gate:offline-01ef4da9 -m unittest discover -s tests -v 2>&1) || rc=$?
summary=$(printf '%s\n' "$output" | grep -E '^Ran [0-9]+ tests in ' | tail -1 || :)
final=$(printf '%s\n' "$output" | grep -E '^(OK|FAILED \()' | tail -1 || :)
test -n "$summary" || summary=NO_TEST_SUMMARY
test -n "$final" || final=NO_FINAL_SUMMARY
gh api -X POST repos/seigo-gace/ai-core/issues/1/comments -f body="AI_CORE_PR3_FINAL_SOURCE_TEST HEAD=01ef4da9ac2b468805179f74925858e6764ef68e EXIT=$rc $summary $final" --jq '.html_url' >/dev/null
echo "AI_CORE_PR3_EXACT_TEST_EXIT=$rc"
exit "$rc"
